Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::makeNewOrder(orderid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		op: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = orderid)
	precondition:
		op.oclIsUndefined() = true
	postcondition:
		let newOp: OrderProduct in
		newOp.oclIsNew() and
		OrderProduct.allInstance()->includes(newOp) and
		newOp.Id = orderid and
		newOp.OrderStatus = OrderProduct::NEW and
		newOp.Time = now and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct = newOp and
		result = true
}
